paraphrase: On Mahādeva mountain the Śiva Sūtras appeared to the teacher Vasugupta by a siddha's command; he gave them with their secret to Bhaṭṭa Kallaṭa, who explained three sections with his own Spanda-sūtras and the last with the commentary Tattvārthacintāmaṇi; the teaching passed to his maternal cousin Pradyumnabhaṭṭa, his son Prajñārjuna, his pupil Mahādevabhaṭṭa, his son Śrīkaṇṭhabhaṭṭa, from whom Bhāskara, son of Divākara, received it.
